pages.title: Mountain Tapir
pages.text: The mountain tapir ($(o)Tapirus pinchaque$()), or woolly tapir, is a tapir found in the cloud forests and high grasslands of the northern Andes in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.$(br2)It is the smallest of the living tapirs and is well adapted to the cold, with a thick, woolly coat.$(br2)Mountain tapirs live at high altitudes, often above 2,000 metres. The species is listed as Endangered.
